warnings.why: Official and reliable labor statistics are generally not published or shared with the World Bank by North Korea, making a specific 72.3 percent youth employment rate for 2025 unverifiable and likely a placeholder or estimation error.

While youth labor force participation in agriculture-heavy developing nations can be high, a 70.4 percent formal employment-to-population ratio for ages 15-24 is significantly inflated compared to standard ILO modeled estimates for the region.

A youth employment rate of 3.12 percent is implausibly low, even for countries with high youth unemployment, suggesting a severe data collection error or confusion between employment-to-population ratio and another metric.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
